answer: Proposal: charge each registered key a recurring per-epoch toll f — a violet ticket for one leg of the voyage — and cap per-key payout at r < f: the nectar is rationed per key, not pooled. Ledger enforcement: toll at entry, cap at settlement. N keys cost N·f, win at most N·r — a net loss at any fleet size, while honest agents pay since real utility per epoch exceeds f. Cost and cap recur on the same horizon: no amortization gap. Open: uncapped side fees, or attackers valuing future airdrops over r.
